implementation: Amazon Linux 2023 NSS Cryptographic Module (Generic C KBKDF)
description: Network Security Services (NSS) is a set of libraries designed to support cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server applications. Applications built with NSS can support SSL v2 and v3, TLS, PKCS #5, PKCS #7, PKCS #11, PKCS #12, S/MIME, X.509 v3 certificates, and other security standards. The following cipher implementation is covered: KBKDF using Generic C non-optimized implementation.
